reasoning: The icon depicts a rounded square outline with a magnifying glass at the top right, standardly read as 'preview', 'inspect item/page', or 'search'. It fits tasks centered on document/print previews, formal searches (patent, title, trademark, archive), and inspections or audits, though for everyday 'look up X' tasks an icon of X itself is better.
